snippet.title: Colorless Poems | Japanese RPG Horror | No Commentary
snippet.description:
"Look for the highest place"
Suggest a game for me to play: https://forms.gle/niSfKnGj2LmrDnuAA
Game: Colorless Poems (色のない詩―ウタ―)
Find the game here: https://yamikazeyami.itch.io/colorless-poems
Original creator: Ryou Mutsumi (睦涼) of Blue Laterne (aoiro-laterne.sakura.ne.jp)
Release Date: 2020
Engine: WOLF RPG Editor
I do NOT own anything on this video, all credit to their respective creators.

If the creator wants me to take this down, please tell me.
もしクリエイターがこれを削除することを望むなら、私に言ってほしい。 (DeepL)

Translated by YamikazeYami.

I've known of the creator of this game for quite a good while now because of their other RPG Maker horror game "Oni Asobi" which got translated by tosiaki. I haven't actually played that one and probably won't because from what I've seen of it I wouldn't enjoy it very much because of its gameplay.

The story's fine enough and kept me speculating when I played and the graphics do their job. The gameplay though can be frustrating at points. The movement speed is also quite slow which was annoying at some points. (Shift didn't work)

Also, this girl has less stamina than me which is certainly something. I guess it just goes that fast so the chases wouldn't be too easy.

Honestly, I just wanted to record something "short" (almost 2 hours whoops) so that I could get back into the groove of recording things and I've thought about playing this for a while now so two birds one stone kind of deal.

I did enjoy this for the most part though. I did use a walkthrough since multi-ending games stress me out especially RPG Horror ones since some have very stupid conditions for their best endings so I do stuff based on that.

(Also fun fact, the Japanese title has a little "Uta" there that isn't included in the English title. Also, I recorded this on October 11th which is why I froze for a bit when it showed 2023/10/11. It's in Japanese order so it's October 11th, 2023. You might realize why I was surprised haha)
